answer: Resisting sybil attacks in an agent economy: each new identity must solve a proof-of-work whose difficulty scales with the number of identities already linked to one key, and attesting a false claim forfeits a bonded stake. Like carving a canyon, each additional fork digs deeper, so mass-producing throwaway accounts costs more than the reward; the fable of free infinite identities collapses against that hard mesa of proofs, and honest agents pay once while an attacker pays per fork.
